project_summary.target_audience: Indonesian (ID) & Thai (TH) Middle and High School Students (SMP & SMA/SMK)
project_summary.app_type: Mobile Web App PWA (Primary viewport: 390px - 430px, Desktop centered container max-width: 720px)
project_summary.redesign_goal: Transform FIEZEL from a jargon-heavy diagnostic app into an exclusive, high-end, luxury-editorial learning experience for students. Simplify all complex wording into student-friendly terms, remove student-irrelevant teacher/diagnostic panels, and deliver an expensive, highly polished UI while preserving core brand identity assets (Wordmark, Brand Yellow, Dark Ink, Cream Base, Paw Mascot).
project_summary.non_negotiables: DO NOT touch teacher panel (Ruang Guru). Preserve vanilla JS compatibility and CSS theme architecture. Maintain 100% WCAG AA contrast compliance.

persona_and_archetype.design_archetype: Luxury Editorial x Premium Fintech for Youth
persona_and_archetype.vibe: Exclusive, tactile, inspiring, frictionless, and high-status. Feels like a world-class magazine combined with a modern sleek learning pass.
persona_and_archetype.mascot_role: Paw the Yellow Cat acts as a subtle, encouraging learning companion (used for micro-cheers, streaks, and quiz feedback—never cluttering structural screens).

rules: Use Instrument Serif for expressive main headings and luxury editorial accent statements.
Use Plus Jakarta Sans for all UI labels, body paragraphs, buttons, options, and readable text.
Use Fredoka sparingly for mascot callouts, streak chips, and playful motivational badges.
Ensure Noto Sans Thai is specified in font stacks for flawless rendering of Thai characters.
Never use pure black (#000000). Always use Dark Ink (#241A11).
Background is warm cream (#FFF9EE) with crisp white (#FFFFFF) card surfaces.
Use 1px borders with dark_ink/12 opacity for sharp, luxury editorial framing.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all body copy and interactive labels.

viewport_constraints.container_class: max-w-[720px] mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FFF9EE] text-[#241A11] pb-24 relative overflow-x-hidden shadow-2xl md:my-4 md:rounded-3xl md:border md:border-[#241A11]/10

panels_to_hide_from_students.reason: Technical diagnostic scans (BKT mastery scores, log-odds, misinterpretation vectors) cause anxiety and confusion for SMP/SMA students.
Algorithmic decision tree details belong in internal logs or teacher views.
Only relevant inside Ruang Guru (Teacher Panel).

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply this design system in the frontend code base.
Ensure all user-facing Indonesian and Thai copies replace raw diagnostic jargon.
Hide or eliminate raw algorithm score displays from student-facing components.
Do NOT touch or break teacher panel functionality (Ruang Guru).
Ensure data-testid attributes are preserved or added for automated test stability.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop, default generic blue cards, or low contrast gray text.
Maintain smooth micro-interactions on all clickable surfaces.
Keep mobile PWA primary view constraint centered for larger screens.
